title: Claim Denied but Policy Was Active
scenario: Customer says a claim was denied even though coverage was active on the date of service.
procedure: Verify member; check effective and termination dates; verify date of service; review denial reason; follow approved reconsideration workflow.
escalation: Escalate if eligibility conflicts or the denial cannot be resolved by the approved process.
aliases: claim denied|rejected claim|coverage active|policy active|date of service

title: How to Check Claim Status
scenario: Customer wants the current status of a submitted claim.
procedure: Verify identity and claim details; review latest status and status date; explain using approved terminology.
escalation: Escalate if beyond the applicable processing timeframe or status is inconsistent.
aliases: claim status|claim update|where is my claim|claim pending

title: Claim Reconsideration Request
scenario: Customer asks for a previously denied claim to be reviewed again.
procedure: Verify claim number; review denial reason; determine whether reconsideration is permitted; collect required information; submit through approved workflow.
escalation: Escalate if outside the standard reconsideration process.

title: Duplicate Claim
scenario: The same service may have been submitted more than once.
procedure: Verify claim numbers, provider, amount and date of service; compare records; follow duplicate-claim procedure.
escalation: Escalate when duplicate status cannot be determined.

title: Missing Claim Information
scenario: A claim cannot be processed because required information is missing.
procedure: Identify missing information; explain what is required; document interaction; follow approved resubmission process.
escalation: Escalate if required fields cannot be updated or records conflict.

title: Incorrect Date of Service
scenario: Customer reports the date of service on a claim is incorrect.
procedure: Verify claim/member details; compare reported date with records; follow correction or resubmission process.
escalation: Escalate if the correct date cannot be validated.

title: Check Eligibility on a Specific Date
scenario: Agent needs to determine whether a member was covered on a particular date.
procedure: Verify identity; check effective date; check termination date; compare dates with the date being investigated.
escalation: Escalate if approved systems show conflicting eligibility.
aliases: eligibility check|covered on date|coverage verification|active coverage

title: Policy Shows Inactive
scenario: Customer says coverage should be active but the system shows inactive.
procedure: Verify identity; review dates; check recent updates; follow approved status-correction process.
escalation: Escalate when status cannot be reconciled.
aliases: inactive policy|coverage inactive|should be active|policy status

title: Coverage Effective Date
scenario: Customer asks when coverage started.
procedure: Verify identity; retrieve policy record; confirm effective date; communicate approved information.
escalation: Escalate if date is missing or inconsistent.
aliases: coverage start date|effective date|when coverage started

title: Coverage Termination Date
scenario: Customer asks when coverage ended.
procedure: Verify identity; retrieve policy record; confirm termination date when available.
escalation: Escalate if records conflict or termination information is unavailable.
aliases: coverage end date|termination date|when coverage ended

title: Eligibility System Mismatch
scenario: Two approved systems show different eligibility information.
procedure: Verify member details; compare identifiers and dates; document mismatch; do not make unsupported coverage decisions.
escalation: Escalate to eligibility support.

title: Dependent Eligibility
scenario: Customer asks whether a dependent is currently covered.
procedure: Verify member/dependent details; check dependent coverage dates; provide permitted information.
escalation: Escalate if dependent record is missing or inconsistent.

title: Duplicate Charge
scenario: Customer reports being charged twice for the same transaction.
procedure: Verify customer and transaction details; compare dates and amounts; determine whether charges are duplicates; follow correction/refund process.
escalation: Escalate if transaction cannot be validated.

title: Refund Status
scenario: Customer asks when an approved refund will be received.
procedure: Verify refund reference; check status; communicate applicable processing timeframe.
escalation: Escalate if refund exceeds approved timeframe.
aliases: refund pending|refund status|where is my refund

title: Payment Failed
scenario: A payment attempt failed.
procedure: Verify transaction status; review approved failure reason; follow payment-retry procedure.
escalation: Escalate if funds appear deducted despite failed status or status is inconsistent.

title: Unexpected Billing Amount
scenario: Customer says billed amount differs from what they expected.
procedure: Verify invoice/transaction; compare amount with applicable plan/service details; explain supported information.
escalation: Escalate if amount cannot be reconciled.

title: Invoice Copy Request
scenario: Customer needs a copy of an invoice.
procedure: Verify identity; locate invoice; provide or direct to approved invoice-access method.
escalation: Escalate if invoice cannot be located.

title: Payment Reversal
scenario: Customer says a payment was reversed or returned.
procedure: Verify payment record; review reversal reason; explain approved next payment step.
escalation: Escalate if reason is unavailable or disputed.

title: New Enrollment Request
scenario: Customer wants to enroll in an available plan or service.
procedure: Verify eligibility; explain approved options; collect required details; complete enrollment workflow.
escalation: Escalate if eligibility cannot be verified or system is unavailable.

title: Enrollment Status
scenario: Customer asks whether a recent enrollment request was completed.
procedure: Verify identity; locate record; check status; communicate current status and next step.
escalation: Escalate if request exceeds expected timeframe.

title: Incorrect Enrollment Information
scenario: Customer says information submitted during enrollment is incorrect.
procedure: Verify identity; identify incorrect field; determine whether it can be corrected; document request.
escalation: Escalate when field cannot be corrected normally.

title: Enrollment Cancellation
scenario: Customer asks to cancel a recent enrollment request.
procedure: Verify identity/status; determine whether cancellation is permitted; follow cancellation procedure.
escalation: Escalate if already finalized.

title: Plan Change Request
scenario: Customer asks to change from one plan to another.
procedure: Verify eligibility and plan-change rules; explain approved options; follow plan-change workflow.
escalation: Escalate if requested change is outside allowed process.

title: Enrollment Confirmation
scenario: Customer needs confirmation that enrollment was submitted successfully.
procedure: Verify identity; locate record; confirm status; provide approved confirmation details.
escalation: Escalate if no record can be found.

title: Member Authentication
scenario: Agent needs to verify identity before discussing account-specific information.
procedure: Follow approved authentication questions and verify required identifiers before disclosure.
escalation: Escalate if authentication fails or extra verification is required.

title: Address Update
scenario: Customer wants to update a mailing or contact address.
procedure: Complete authentication; collect new address; update using approved workflow; confirm submission.
escalation: Escalate if address cannot be updated.

title: Phone or Email Update
scenario: Customer wants to change phone number or email.
procedure: Authenticate; collect new contact information; update using approved workflow; confirm update.
escalation: Escalate if update fails or extra verification is required.

title: Replacement Member Card
scenario: Customer requests a replacement member card.
procedure: Verify identity; check member record; determine eligibility; follow card-request process.
escalation: Escalate if record prevents request.

title: General Account Inquiry
scenario: Customer asks about an issue that does not clearly match another category.
procedure: Authenticate; clarify issue; search approved knowledge base; document interaction.
escalation: Escalate if no approved article addresses it.

title: Privacy or Restricted Information
scenario: Customer asks for information that may be protected or restricted.
procedure: Authenticate; determine whether information may be disclosed; follow privacy procedure.
escalation: Escalate requests outside approved disclosure process.

title: Supervisor Escalation
scenario: Agent cannot resolve an issue using available knowledge and standard procedures.
procedure: Confirm standard troubleshooting; document issue/actions; route to supervisor or SME.
escalation: Escalate when authority, access, or a decision outside the agent role is required.

title: System Incident Escalation
scenario: Required system is unavailable or produces an error that blocks case handling.
procedure: Capture error and non-sensitive details; check incident procedure; document impact.
escalation: Escalate according to system incident process.

title: Knowledge Gap
scenario: Agent cannot find an article that answers a new customer scenario.
procedure: Search relevant terms; confirm no applicable article; document question and impact.
escalation: Escalate to SME/knowledge team and flag as potential knowledge gap.

title: Urgent Escalation
scenario: Customer situation matches an approved urgent-escalation condition.
procedure: Verify required information; follow urgent escalation route; do not promise unauthorized outcomes.
escalation: Use the urgent route defined by the process.

title: Conflicting Knowledge Articles
scenario: Two approved articles appear to give different instructions.
procedure: Check version/effective date; do not choose based on preference; document conflict.
escalation: Escalate to knowledge-management/SME team.

title: Out-of-Scope Request
scenario: Customer asks for an action outside agent responsibilities.
procedure: Explain approved options; document request; follow transfer/escalation process.
escalation: Escalate or transfer according to ownership.

title: Customer Requests a Supervisor
scenario: Customer explicitly asks to speak with a supervisor.
procedure: Acknowledge request; understand reason; follow supervisor-escalation process; document.
escalation: Transfer/escalate according to policy.

title: Customer Is Frustrated
scenario: Customer is upset or repeatedly explains the same problem.
procedure: Acknowledge concern; listen; summarize issue; explain next actionable step using approved information.
escalation: Escalate if requested or if criteria are met.

title: Customer Requests a Policy Exception
scenario: Customer requests an exception to a standard rule.
procedure: Clarify request; explain standard process; do not promise exception; check approved exception path.
escalation: Escalate when authorized exception decision is required.

title: Customer Wants Immediate Resolution
scenario: Customer demands an outcome that requires processing time or another team.
procedure: Explain what can be completed now; provide approved next step/timeframe; avoid unsupported promises.
escalation: Escalate if approved urgent criteria apply.

title: Required Verification Missing
scenario: Quality review finds an agent missed a required verification step.
procedure: Identify missed verification; document QA finding; provide coaching using approved quality framework.
escalation: Escalate compliance-related issues per QA policy.

title: Incorrect Information Provided
scenario: Quality review finds information given by an agent was unsupported by the knowledge base.
procedure: Compare response with current article; correct coaching/knowledge issue; document finding.
escalation: Escalate if article itself is outdated or conflicting.

title: Knowledge Article Feedback
scenario: Agent finds an article unclear, outdated, incomplete, or hard to use.
procedure: Record article ID; describe issue; provide example scenario; submit feedback.
escalation: Escalate immediately if incorrect guidance could affect customers/compliance.

title: Knowledge Article Version Check
scenario: Agent needs to determine whether an article is current.
procedure: Check version and effective date; use latest approved version; do not rely on unofficial copies.
escalation: Escalate if multiple active versions appear.
